bio.text: Julie McCluskie, a Democrat, represents District 13 in the Colorado House of Representatives and is Speaker of the House; she became speaker on January 8, 2024.
She represented House District 61 from 2019 to 2023, and according to Ballotpedia she is not running for re-election to District 13 in 2026.
McCluskie was born and raised in Colorado and received a bachelor's degree in chemistry and biochemistry from Colorado State University.

Her career experience includes working as communications coordinator for Summit School District, regional development officer for Colorado Mountain College, and Director of Communications for the state of Colorado.
